decision: accepted; promoted inside E28b with a 16 GiB KV pool
statement: The owner accepted E28 after reviewing the three suites, the acceptance probes with and without thinking, the user-experience trade-offs and the memory impact, then asked to raise the KV pool to 16 GiB so that five full-length agents fit together. E28b, measured separately, was promoted.
accepted_trade_off: Code decode +10.5% on long answers (and faster code reasoning with thinking) against about +56 ms C1 per-stream TTFT, cached-replay TTFT about +80-110 ms at 8K-32K, C1 end-to-end -2.2% on 256-token answers and 4.9% less KV token capacity in the same 15 GiB pool (1,278,751 tokens; five simultaneous agents fit about 255,750 tokens each instead of 262,144).
follow_up: Raise the KV pool to 16 GiB (E28b); explain the cached-replay TTFT cost.
